name: Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens
positioning: Beach resort on the Athens Riviera in Vouliagmeni, with three private beaches on the Aegean Sea
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort on the Athens Riviera
Families looking for a kids club

facts.text: The hotel has 303 rooms in total.
The hotel is at 40 Apollonos Street, Vouliagmeni, Athens.
The estate has three private beaches along the Aegean Sea.
Pelagos was awarded one Michelin star.
Mercato is an upscale Italian restaurant.
Taverna 37 is a beachfront traditional Greek taverna.
Helios has a Latin American vibe and a sharing menu.
The spa has a heated indoor pool.

highlights.text: The Arion rooms and suites have modernist architecture and a stylish retro-chic design.
The Bungalows retain the same glamorous allure today as they did in the 1960s.
Nafsika offers azure sea views from every room and suite.
Water sports are available directly from the boardwalk from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm daily.
The hotel has a fully supervised kids club.

considerations.text: The hotel is 30 minutes from Athens' city centre.
The three private beaches are in seasonal operation from April to October.
The two outdoor pools are in seasonal operation from March to October.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is outside central Athens and requires transportation.
